verdict.rationale: A live probe found an official llms.txt at https://otter.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200) that describes Otter.ai, so an agent can be pointed at a first-party agent-oriented entry point. However, only its opening line is evidenced, and the Public API is documented in a single prose help article with no machine-readable spec. missing for 10: evidence of what the llms.txt actually covers (API/MCP docs, linked markdown pages), machine-readable or agent-oriented API reference (openapi.json returns 404), independent hands-on corroboration of agents using it.
